messages:
taylor: Heads up — release window opens tomorrow 9am PT. Need final SDK version bump, docs regen, and console deploy. Any blockers?

jamal: Working on changelog PR (will link). Need sign-off for the breaking change note.

maya: There's a failing unit in sdk-types that I'll fix today. Might risk the cutoff if it takes longer.

sasha: Docs regen can run once the tag is cut. I can trigger docsite build but need the exact artifact name / version.

taylor: We'll use v1.12.0. schema change is noted. @maya can you confirm PR number?

maya: PR #4567 — added the migration snippet. Pushed a fix branch, will open a follow-up if needed.

ci-bot: CI: main build passed (commit abc123). Docs build queued for v1.12.0.

qa: Quick smoke on staging console: two small CSS regressions. Not blocking for functionality, but calling them out.

jamal: Changelog entry updated in PR #4559 and linked in release PR. Please add :+1: if okay.

sasha: Kicked off docs regen for tag v1.12.0 — build URL: https://staging-docs.redwood.com/builds/789 (monitoring)

maya: Tests fixed and force-pushed to PR #4567. Will add migration note to changelog.

taylor: Plan: if docs are green by 6pm PT we'll cut the tag & release. If not, move to tomorrow 9am. Any objections?

qa: We'll do final smoke at 6:15 and post results here.

jamal: I'll bump package.json to 1.12.0 and prepare the release PR, then await tag.

sasha: :thumbsup:

taylor: Thanks everyone. @sasha @jamal @maya post final confirmations here and I'll cut the tag with:
```
git tag -a v1.12.0 -m "release v1.12.0"
git push origin v1.12.0
```

sasha: Docs build green at 17:49 PT — all pages rendering. Link: https://staging-docs.redwood.com/builds/789/green

jamal: Release PR merged, package bumped, changelog included. Ready for tag.

maya: Migration snippet verified by QA, tests passing in branch. Good to cut.

taylor: Tagging now. Good work everyone :rocket:
